class.name: BoundBox
class.description: BoundBox represents a 3D bounding box that encloses a shape or set of points. It is constructed from a TopoDS_Shape using OpenCASCADE's Bnd_Box class. The box is defined by minimum and maximum corner points.

method.name: create_from_bnd_box
method.argument: Raw byte array containing Bnd_Box data.
method.description: Creates a new BoundBox from raw Bnd_Box data.

method.name: create_from_shape
method.argument: A Shape object to compute the bounding box from.
Tolerance for the bounding box computation.
If true, uses optimal bounding box algorithm.
method.description: Creates a new BoundBox from a Shape. Note: Full implementation depends on Shape class.

method.name: add_point
method.argument: A point to add to the bounding box.
method.description: Adds a point to the bounding box, expanding it if necessary.

method.name: add_box
method.description: Adds another bounding box to this one, expanding to encompass both.

method.name: center
method.description: Returns the center point of the bounding box.

method.name: is_inside
method.description: Returns true if the other bounding box is entirely inside this one.

method.name: overlaps
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box overlaps with another.

method.name: to_align_offset
method.description: Returns the offset for aligning objects based on this bounding box. Note: Full implementation depends on Align enum.

method.name: get_measure
method.description: Returns the measure of the bounding box. For 3D: volume, for 2D: area, for 1D: length.

method.name: get_diagonal
method.description: Returns the length of the body diagonal (maximum size).

members.member: The minimum corner point of the bounding box.
The maximum corner point of the bounding box.
The size of the bounding box (max - min).
